fixed_inputs: Original market/news/fundamental reports and per-day as-of memory. Prior original news label outputs reused for AAPL; AMZN newly generated.
news_analysis: Historical seven-day snapshots, max20 latest deduplicated titles/summaries. Article IDs, relevance, ordinal score [-2,2], exact quote, reason and confidence; strict source validation.
eodhd: Latest record strictly before signal calendar date. Raw score, day change, z-score against 20 strictly earlier observations, count, date and timing limitations. Prior-day alignment is provisional.
pipeline: News labels, combined sentiment interpretation, bull, bear, research manager, trader, aggressive/conservative/neutral risk, portfolio manager.
comparisons: Archived original multi-agent and Buy and Hold for both stocks; additional archived same-implementation news-only control for AAPL only.
limitations: Retrospective public demo data: historical release time, timezone, revisions and production parity unverified.
Original archived reports inherit information-cutoff limitations. Not established to be leakage-free.
Combined data and interpretation treatment, separate stochastic model invocations and archived controls prevent isolated causal attribution.
Two stocks over one previously explored month. No held-out or statistical generalization claim.
Binary execution can interpret a narrative Hold of an unspecified core allocation as continued cash. Narrative conditional orders are not executed.
